Invoices is everything you have billed, across every project and every customer, in one list.
Filter it down by project, by status, by signature status, or by when it was raised — so you can see just the ones still unsigned, or just this month's.
Each row carries the project, the amount, where it has got to, and whether it has been signed.
To bill something new, New Invoice, pick the project, and you land in the same editor you have already seen.
